## 📦 Install

Search for **Biolume** in the Extensions view, or install this version from the command line:

```sh
code --install-extension kostad02.biolume@__VERSION__
```

| Registry                                                                                          | For                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| [Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=kostad02.biolume) | VS Code                                |
| [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/kostad02/biolume)                                       | VSCodium and other editors that use it |

**`biolume-__VERSION__.vsix`** attached below is the same package. To install it by hand, run
**Extensions: Install from VSIX...** and pick the file.

## 🎨 Themes

- **Biolume**: deep navy with a mint glow.
- **Biolume Light**: soft paper with deep green accents.
